method.objective: Find public GTIN/barcode evidence without inferring from internal SKU strings.

result.interpretation: No matching agricultural GTIN surfaced in the 30 exact-SKU public-web checks. Numeric SKU collisions with unrelated global products were explicitly rejected.

rejected_false_positive_examples.unrelated_result: MKS valve kit / unrelated retail item identifiers

corroborated_family_evidence.promotion_policy: Do not write as exact SKU fact unless exact model mapping is independently verified.
Do not infer exact connection details without exact model evidence.

gtin_policy: Absence of a public match is recorded as not_publicly_verified. Never copy a GTIN from an unrelated numeric collision.
compatibility_policy: Same nominal size or title text is insufficient for hard compatibility. Exact connection standard, material and pressure evidence is required.
price_stock_policy: No price, sale price, discount, coupon, stock, or availability values were changed.
